name: After a Broker reassignment, the offer email goes to the new broker
description:
Objective: After a Broker reassignment, the offer email goes to the new broker.
Preconditions: Open Application editing ownership with the configured test data.
Steps:
1. Open Application editing ownership.
2. After a Broker reassignment, the offer email goes to the new broker.
3. Observe the resulting state.
Expected: The expected message or notification is delivered once with the relevant details.
